message: We've all been there—it's the middle of a favorite show, and suddenly the lights go out, leaving us in the dark and wondering if our phones will even make it through the night. I found a really useful resource from the Red Cross that can help us prepare for those pesky power outages. It’s all about having a plan and some essentials ready to go, so we don’t end up feeling lost when the power dips. How do you stay calm during a blackout?
